reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: deep learning potentials trained on ab initio data are known to capture complex many-body interactions and improve phase-space overlap, making the predicted reduction in thermodynamic integration path mismatch plausible for high-entropy alloy liquids.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a decisive falsification criterion (statistically insignificant mismatch reduction or failure to converge to benchmarks), though the practical feasibility of generating sufficient ab initio training data for multicomponent liquids is a minor gap.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the core methodological limitation of EAM references in TOR-TILD and proposes a concrete, modern solution that would be highly valuable for researchers working on high-temperature free energy calculations of HEAs.
